title: macOS Identity-Threat & Account-Lockout Hardening (Password Spray, Smart Lockout, SecureToken)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (macOS + Microsoft Intune/Entra; configuration/identity/security work, live-fleet care).
White-label; Apple/Microsoft console internals authored click-by-click from public docs; anything uncertain flagged, not invented.
hook: Stop Macs from triggering account lockouts and credential attacks
problem: macOS clients with saved or stale credentials can hammer Entra ID with failed sign-ins — feeding password-spray detections and triggering account lockouts that block legitimate users, sometimes tangled up with SecureToken/keychain state. This solution hardens the identity posture of the Mac fleet: understand and mitigate lockout sources, enforce Entra Smart Lockout and MFA, and clean up the Mac-side credential state that causes repeat failures — under Zero-Trust and least-privilege.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how macOS authentication, saved credentials, and keychain/SecureToken state contribute to failed sign-ins, lockouts, and password-spray noise, and the hardening model.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites (Entra sign-in logs / Identity Protection, Smart Lockout, MFA, Intune, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.

Implementation Guide — exact steps to identify Mac-originated lockout/spray sources from sign-in logs, enforce Smart Lockout + MFA, remediate stale Mac-side credentials/keychain, and validate the reduction, then expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — sign-in-failure/lockout discovery (by device/OS), per-device credential-state validation, a lockout/spray exposure report, safe remediation guidance, and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (lockout sources identified, failures reduced) plus Best Practices for identity protection on Macs.
short: Harden the identity posture of the Mac fleet — find and stop Mac-originated failed sign-ins that drive password-spray detections and account lockouts, enforce Smart Lockout + MFA, and clean up stale Mac credential state. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
